- **Fields that exist on the Problem table:** Category, Configuration item, State, Impact, Urgency, Priority, Assignment group, Problem statement and Description are all on the Problem form. Subcategory is there too, but it only appears after a Category such as "Hardware" is picked.

B. Navigate to Reports > Create New -> choose table = Incident -> group by Assigned to -> add metrics (resolution time, open count, reassignment count) -> Run -> analyze results to identify underperforming agents.
C. Navigate to Reports > View/Run -> click the All (or Global) tab -> search Open Incidents by Assigned to -> open the closest match -> review current workload levels per agent.

F. Navigate to Analytics Hub (or Performance Analytics) -> Dashboards -> open a Service Desk/Incident dashboard -> add a breakdown by Assigned to and a time period -> drill down into specific incidents to find bottlenecks.
G. Navigate to Reports > View/Run -> search Incident + Performance/Assignment/Resolved -> open the closest match -> then pivot/group by Assigned to and filter to Resolved/Closed in the last X days.
H. Navigate to Reports > Create New -> table = Incident -> choose Bar or Pivot -> group by Assigned to (optionally add State/Resolution time) -> set filters (Resolved/Closed + last X days + assignment group) -> Save and Run.

A. Self-Service, User Administration, Task
B. HR Case Management, Lifecycle Events
C. User Administration, System Security, Task
D. Assets, Task
E. Assets, System Security

G. HR Case Management, User Administration
H. Self-Service, Lifecycle Events, HR Case Management

Put your final answer into \boxed{} format like \boxed{A}.

results.answer:
The answer is **E. Assets, System Security**.

The knowledge base has a user offboarding procedure that goes through these two applications:

1. **Assets:** Go to Asset > Portfolios > Hardware Assets and filter on "Assigned to" = the user. Open each matching asset, clear the "Assigned to" field and click Update.
2. **System Security:** Go to System Security > Users and Groups > Users. Find the user, open their record, click Delete and confirm the cascade deletion.
